description: For infinite \(\kappa\), a nonempty \(\kappa\)-saturated structure \(M\) with \(|M|\le\kappa\), a subset \(A\subseteq M\) of size below \(\kappa\), and finite tuples \(\bar a,\bar b\) with the same complete type over \(A\), there is an automorphism fixing \(A\) pointwise and satisfying \(e(a_i)=b_i\) for every coordinate.
